notes: Knight shield bash (mw-e04.14): attack while blocking (block + attack), 14/4/20 ticks, 18 stamina, 5 blunt, 45 poise, a 150 N·s forward impulse. Its hits are tagged interrupt (a target in a move flagged interruptible, e.g. a spell windup, has it cancelled and flinches) and guard-crush (a shieldless guard breaks outright for 60 ticks). World impact: a 150 N·s shove along the facing that moves things up to 60 kg (5 m/s for a 30 kg barrel; anything heavier resists, ImpactResisted) and 60 J of blunt impact for breakables (a flimsy barricade). staminaDamage 30, impactForce 1200 N and the 60 J are placeholders until e04-smash-breakables and the combat sandbox tune them.
